name: Edison Format

defining_events.name: Shonen Jump Championship Edison, New Jersey (75th SJC)

notes: period: the March 2010 TCG list took effect 2010-03-01 and EdisonFormat.com bounds the format at 2010-05-10, the day before The Shining Darkness's NA release; snapshot is SJC Edison day 1 (2010-04-24), the event the format is named for. chronology: Format Library names the neighbours 'Lightsworn' (previous) and 'Frog' (next); left null here until those formats exist in this repository. card_pool: materialised from data/releases/ and cross-checked against YGOPRODeck's Edison tag and the termitaklk community whitelist (see the pool record's notes for the adjudicated differences). errata: functional errata relevant to 2010 (e.g. cards later errata'd) are not yet dated in data/errata/, so no overrides apply — the generated list uses modern implementations for now; see docs/roadmap.md.
